name: ClinicalMonitoringVisitTracker
tagline: CRA monitoring visits, SDV progress, findings, action items and follow-up letters – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete clinical monitoring app for sponsors and CROs: plan and confirm visits, record SDV/SDR, log findings with escalation and corrective action items, run a four-eyes report review, generate the follow-up letter, carry open items forward and see every site's SDV and next visit due by risk. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box. Not a medical device.
controlType: standard (2 controls: ClinicalMonitoringVisitTracker dataset + ClinicalMonitoringVisitTrackerPortal field control)
